evidence.title: AICSS · UI components for AI agents

name: AICSS
summary: Copy-paste UI components for AI agent conversations: thinking states, tool calls, streaming text, citations and tables.
description: A library of UI components for AI agent chat interfaces, grouped into Thinking & Reasoning, Tool & Action States, Text Outputs, Structured Outputs and Rich & Interactive. Free components ship React, Vue and Svelte code; a one-time Pro license unlocks the rest. Components are also served as JSON and Markdown through a registry API for programmatic use.
contains: 10 free components; the rest unlock with a one-time Pro license
groups: Thinking & Reasoning, Tool & Action States, Text Outputs, Structured Outputs, Rich & Interactive
every component ships React, Vue and Svelte code; snippets are self-contained CSS
JSON API: /r index plus /r/{slug} per component, with an optional Markdown prompt format
